purpose: Independent input-to-expected-output vectors for concrete workspace defects found before browser verification.
reviewStatus: Static adversarial review of workspace.tsx and preferences.ts; not executed browser tests.

cases.name: Coverage cell preserves the clicked source

input.action: Activate the Documents required / Scholarship listing conflict cell

expected.targetQuote: Income proof: Form 16 or ITR of parents.

cases.observedDefect: The cell identifies a finding that contains listing evidence, but selectFinding navigates evidence[0], which belongs to guidelines.
cases.verificationNote: Source identity comes from the clicked column, independently of finding evidence order.

cases.name: Rejected duplicate source does not create a phantom active tab
cases.observedDefect: addDrafts skips the duplicate in its state updater but then unconditionally opens items[0].input.id, even when that ID was not accepted.
cases.verificationNote: The expected active tab must refer to a source actually present in the workspace.

cases.name: Comparison-row quotes have source navigation

input.state: Income-certificate passage selected in the guidelines
input.action: Choose Check against other sources, then activate evidence in the listing comparison row

row.quote: Income proof: Form 16 or ITR of parents.

expected.targetQuote: Income proof: Form 16 or ITR of parents.

cases.observedDefect: sourceComparison renders a title, result, and quote block but no citation or Show in source action.
cases.verificationNote: A visible quote alone does not provide the promised one-click inspection path.

cases.name: Product copy does not imply gaps have quoted evidence

input.state: Welcome screen or sample gap finding

expected.provenanceClaim: Every sourced finding cites a passage

cases.observedDefect: The welcome promise says Every finding has a source, even though gap findings intentionally have empty evidence.
cases.verificationNote: This checks product meaning rather than requiring one particular visual treatment.

cases.name: Rejected local-file read recovers the upload form

input.state: Upload method with existing valid draft sources
input.action: Select a nonempty TXT file whose local read rejects with NotReadableError

cases.observedDefect: The File.text await has no catch/finally; a rejection bypasses setBusy(false) and leaves the upload form stuck.
cases.verificationNote: The expected result follows a real browser File API failure path without assuming successful extraction.

cases.name: A stale file read cannot repopulate a reset workspace

input.initialState: User starts reading a TXT file in an upload form
actions: Choose New analysis before read completes

cases.observedDefect: The old SourceForm closure invokes onAdd after awaiting file text without checking whether the form/session has been reset or unmounted.
cases.verificationNote: A later read belongs to the session that started it; it does not authorize insertion into a new session.

cases.name: Touch passage toolbar avoids native selection handles

input.action: Select a passage in the upper half of a source page

expected.toolbarPosition: Below the selection when space allows

cases.observedDefect: The toolbar uses the same prefer-above calculation for every pointer type and has no touch-specific placement.
cases.verificationNote: Actual handle overlap still requires a touch-capable browser check; the missing touch placement is visible in the implementation.

cases.name: Ask action on custom preview explains the unavailable backend

input.state: Local custom TXT/PDF preview, with no completed sample analysis
input.action: Select source text and choose Ask about this

cases.observedDefect: addContext accepts the selection and switches Ask, but the !analysis branch renders only the empty assistant panel and hides the composer and captured quote.
cases.verificationNote: The sample-first contract permits unavailable live AI; it requires an honest actionable explanation instead of a dead control.
